description: 10.0 kohm +/-1% thick film chip resistor, 0402, 0.063 W standard / 0.10 W extended, +/-100 ppm/K

pins.description: Terminal 1. A chip resistor is symmetric; terminal order carries no meaning.

conditions.note: STANDARD operation class: max dR/R <=1% at 1000 h, <=2% at 8000 h. The headline P70 figure on page 1 is the EXTENDED class, recorded separately below.
EXTENDED operation class: the higher rating is bought with a relaxed drift specification -- max dR/R <=2% at 1000 h and NO 8000 h class -- a material distinction for a +/-1% part.
AC RMS or DC, whichever applies. STANDARD operation class; see power_dissipation.
AC RMS or DC, whichever applies. EXTENDED operation class; see power_dissipation_extended.

sources.doc_title: D/CRCW e3 - Standard Thick Film Chip Resistors

provenance.note: Record default. This is a SERIES datasheet: every value here is the series specification for the 0402 size, which is how catalogue passives are specified. No part-specific document exists.

/mpn.locator: PART NUMBER AND PRODUCT DESCRIPTION, page 3
/mpn.note: Composed from the vendor's own documented part-number grammar rather than copied from a distributor listing: CRCW0402 (type/size) + 10K0 (resistance, K = thousand) + F (tolerance +/-1%) + K (TCR +/-100 ppm/K) + ED (packaging, 10 000 pieces on a 7 inch reel, the 0402 option). The datasheet's worked example CRCW0603562RFKEA follows the same grammar.

/parameters/resistance.locator: TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS, Resistance range and Resistance tolerance rows; part-number grammar page 3
/parameters/resistance.note: The nominal 10.0 kohm comes from the part number's 10K0 field and lies inside the series range (1 ohm to 10 Mohm). The interval 9.9 to 10.1 kohm is the +/-1% tolerance evaluated at that nominal - arithmetic on stated values, so datasheet-derived rather than datasheet-stated. The tolerance itself is recorded separately and unevaluated in /parameters/resistance_tolerance.

/parameters/temperature_coefficient.note: Series offers +/-200 and +/-100 ppm/K; the K field in this part number selects +/-100.

/ratings.locator: TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS table, D10/CRCW0402 e3 column, page 1; Maximum Resistance Change at Rated Dissipation and Operating Voltage table, page 2 (standard vs extended operation)
/ratings.note: Page 1's headline row (0.10 W P70, 75 V Umax) carries footnote (2) to the page-2 standard/extended table: STANDARD operation for this size is 0.063 W / 50 V at max dR/R <=1%/1000 h, and 0.10 W / 75 V is the EXTENDED class at <=2%/1000 h with no 8000 h spec. Both classes are transcribed, labelled, and the safe class is the default-named one. Rated dissipation is P70 - at 70 C ambient, not 25 C - so the ambient condition is recorded with it; derating above 70 C follows the datasheet's curve, which this record does not transcribe. An earlier revision of this record shipped the extended figures as the unconditional recommended ratings: a budget checker would have over-rated the part 1.6x with no drift caveat.

notes:
This record exists to exercise the schema's MINIMAL FLOOR: the roughly 80 jellybean passives of the D5 seed library look like this. It carries no modes (a passive draws no supply current), no per-pin capability, no units, and no per-pin characteristics - and it is still a complete, checkable record. A schema that forced integrated-circuit structure onto a chip resistor would make the bulk of the seed library unauthorable, so the absence of those fields here is the point.

Power and voltage are recorded in BOTH of the datasheet's operation classes: standard (0.063 W / 50 V, the tighter <=1%/1000 h drift class) under the default names, extended (0.10 W / 75 V, <=2%/1000 h, no 8000 h class) under *_extended. An earlier revision shipped only the extended figures, unconditionally, and its notes attributed the 0.063 W / 50 V figures to "older CRCW generations" -- the live document publishes them as this series' STANDARD class, so that sentence was the remembered-but-wrong value this record claims to avoid. Round 15 caught it against the fetched datasheet.

Benchmark (c) specifies Yageo RC-series 0402 resistors rather than this Vishay part. Populating the exact benchmark MPNs is AMB-58's scope; this record demonstrates the shape with a part whose datasheet was retrievable and hashable at authoring time.
